newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo Wellcome makes changes in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo Wellcome makes changes in Japan.

text.p: Drugs giant Glaxo Wellcome said on Tuesday it is reorganising the management of its Japanese ventures, Nippon Glaxo and Nippon Wellcome.
Christopher Adam -- recently appointed regional director for Japan -- would stand down from his position as Nippon Wellcome president to be president of Glaxo Wellcome, the firm said.
Adam will, however, remain on the board of Nippon Wellcome.
Darek Winstanly -- currently disease director in the group's commercial development organisation -- would take over as president of Nippon Wellcome, its statement said.
The changes come barely three weeks after Glaxo Wellcome acquired full control of Nippon Glaxo.
The UK giant announced on November 21 that it had bought the ramaining 50 percent of its earlier joint venture Nippon Glaxo for 354 million stg.
Richard Sykes will remain chairman of Nippon Glaxo.
The new appointments come into effect from early 1997.
